fees.note: Town of Lisbon Season Rates 2024, the sheet its 2026 season page still links: residents $29.76 (30-amp water/electric), $31.97 (50-amp W/E), $34.17 (30-amp full hookup), $36.38 (50-amp full hookup), tent/dry $23.15 a night; non-residents $36.38 / $38.58 / $40.79 / $41.90, tent $24.15. Non-resident beach day pass $5 a car.

source: https://www.townoflisbonny.gov/uploads/1/0/6/1/106146027/cce_20240514_125932_0001-1.pdf (Season Rates 2024, linked from townoflisbonny.gov/beach-and-campground.html for the 2026 season; read 2026-10-11)

fees.note: Village of Ilion RV site reservation agreement (linked from the marina page): daily $50, weekly $250, monthly $600, seasonal $2,000; season May 1 - October 15. Each site has cable and all utilities, 50 or 30 amp.

source: https://www.ilionny.gov/qdynamo/download.php?docid=1163 (Marina RV Reservation form, linked from ilionny.gov/recreation/index.php?id=408; read 2026-10-11)

fees.note: City of Carmi Burrell Woods page: RV site $25, tent site $15 a night; reserve online (FireFly); 14-night limit per site; sites 1-7 are 4-month seasonal sites. A Campendium camper reported $28 in June 2025.

source: https://cityofcarmi.org/burrellwoodsonline (city page text via the search index, 2026-10-11; the live page shows a Cloudflare check to the browser)

fees.note: City of Pittsfield lake page: RV water and electric hookup $20 a day ($500 for 30 days), primitive camping $5; tents on an RV pad $20. First come, first served; a ranger collects payment morning and evening.

Nemaha NRD Duck Creek page: 'RV Electrical Camping - $20 / night' on 28 pads, all 50-amp; primitive and tent camping $5; first come, first served, 14-day maximum; no dump station or water hookups. A Nemaha NRD park permit is also required.
Village of Oxford RV park page: 'Camping Fee is $10.00 per night.' Registration forms are in the box at the park; an after-hours electric hookup costs $20 extra.

Jackson County Wazee terms and conditions 2025: camping $20 per unit per night, $10 advance reservation fee, vehicle admission $5 a day or $30 a year. Advance reservations need 3 nights; same-day online registration has no minimum.
City of Mondovi: 'Camping fee $20/night ($120/7 nights). Maximum stay of 7 days.' Electric and water sites, May to October 1.

South Sauty Creek Resort on Campspot, one night Oct 20-21 2026: RV sites (Bannister Bayou, Martin Drive, Nicks Point) $44, Northshore waterview $54; one site group requires RVs 10 years old or newer; 3-night minimum on holidays.
RV Life reviewers paid $43 (April 2026), $40 (May 2026), $40 and $44 (August 2026) and $43 (October 2026). The campground has no page of its own; confirm by phone.
Wills Creek booking engine (SteadyStays): back-in and pull-through full-hookup RV sites 'starting at' $50 a night; primitive tent sites $20; cabins from $75.

City of Sebeka Fee Schedule 2026: camping with electric $30 a night, $180 a week (7 nights paid in advance), $725 for 4 weeks, $2,000 for the season (Memorial Day - Labor Day); tenting (non-electric) $15; dumping $5.

source: https://cdn.townweb.com/cityofsebeka.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Fee-Schedule-2026.pdf (Fee Schedule 2026, linked from the city's parks page; read 2026-10-11)

fees.note: Nobles County park rules & fees: electric sites $25 a night, non-electric $15, 7 nights $150, 14 nights $300, monthly $450, seasonal (May 1 - Labor Day weekend) $950; rates halved after Labor Day weekend.
Douglas County parks page: 'Chippewa Park has a public campground. The fee is $35.00 per night.' Reserve online (ResNexus).

Village of New London 2026 parks brochure: water and electric $50, full hookup $60 a night, primitive $40 (weekly and monthly rates; special events add $20 a night). Rates cover 2 adults and 2 children; extra people $5.
City of Columbus parks page: no reservations, first come first served, '$20/per day fee that can be paid at City Hall'.
A Campendium reviewer paid $13 a night for a full-hookup site in June 2024, at City Hall or the drop box. The Village of Ewing has no web page; confirm by phone.
City of Sinton RV park page: 'Daily Rate: $42.00, Weekly Rate: $205.00, Monthly Rate: $500.00'; prices include utilities and full hookup.
Mono County Public Works page: 'A daily fee is still at $16 per campsite per day.' No drinking water in the campground.
Jack's Landing 2026 price list: camping rustic $30, electric (15/30-amp) $37, electric and water $42 a night plus tax, 4 people per site (extra guests $8); weekly 10% off.
Big Bear Lake Family Resort rate card: camping with electric and water $40, primitive $30 per day per unit (2 adults, 3 children, 2 vehicles); swimming $3 a person; extra people $5.
Ted & Tracy's rates page: camper van / small camper site $50 a day ($300 a week), regular sites near the entrance $55, mid-park $67, creekside $69; all with water and sewer. 'The Island' site $149.
Dogwood RV Park pricing page: RV site $40 a day, $225 a week, $475 a month, including fiber Wi-Fi, electricity, water and sewer.
Rollin' On The River rates page: $45 a night Sunday-Thursday, $55 Friday-Saturday, $250 a week, $525 a month plus electric; full hookups, 4 people per site ($5 per extra person).

Provo River Resort's Campspot engine, one night Oct 20-21 2026: site types priced in their names - back-in sites $30, $40, $60 and $70, premium back-in and pull-through $80, riverfront $120-190; Campspot adds about $8 plus 3% in fees. Water and electric, no sewer hookups.
Horseshoe Inn & Campground RV park page, summer rates: 30-amp $45 a night ($280 a week, $450 a month), 50-amp $55 ($345 / $500); 16 sites, 8 full hookup.

BaseCamp RV's Campspot engine, one night Oct 20-21 2026, with Campspot's fee and before tax: dry site $33.90, 30-amp partial hookup $39.05, 50-amp partial $44.20, 30-amp full hookup $54.50, 50-amp full $59.65.
Encore Gulf Air booking engine, one night Nov 10-11 2026: standard full hookup (Nov-March RVs 40 ft or less) $68, premium $84, elite $93 a night; weekly rates lower.
Encore Tranquility Lakes booking engine, one night Nov 10-11 2026: deluxe full-hookup RV sites $114, deluxe lakefront back-in $136, lakefront $147 a night (weekly rates lower).
koa.com booking for February 2027, read by AWH on 2026-10-05: back-in full hookup (50/30/20 amp) $104.50 a night, lakeside back-in $156.75.

source: koa.com booking, February 2027 dates, read by AWH 2026-10-05 (inclusion_evidence)

fees.note: A Campendium reviewer paid C$40 a night in September 2025 (RV Life reviewers paid C$40 in July and August 2024). The park has no web page; the manager collects the fee in the evening. Confirm by phone.
RV Life reviewers paid C$35 (July 2026), C$40 (August 2026) and C$33 (September 2026). The park has no web page, only Facebook; confirm by phone.
The OldMill RV Park services page: an extra tent or trailer on a site 'will be charged the full $22 nightly rate'; prices subject to change. Book by phone or email.

Riverbend Wilderness Camping rates page: electricity and water sites for RV or tent C$65 a night; its Campspot engine quoted C$68 for those sites and C$78 for premium full-service back-ins (one night, Oct 14-15 2026). Riverside tent sites C$45; some tent areas need 2 nights.
Let's Camp booking page for Camping St. Leonard: 'Price starting at $38 CAD/night'.

Village of Rockyford campground pricing: full service C$35 a night (C$811.13 a month), power and water C$30 (C$757.05), dry camping C$15; dumping free with camping. Online booking on Campspot opens May 1.
Prairie Junction on Campspot, one night Oct 20-21 2026: standard and premium full-hookup RV sites C$56, overflow site C$51, tent site C$46.

Camping Aux flots bleus camping page: seaside 3-service C$70, 2-service C$60; other sites 3-service C$60, 2-service C$50, no service C$40 a night plus taxes; 2-night minimum, 50% non-refundable deposit, C$6 booking fee. Open May 31 - September 30.

Camping Parc Bromont 2026 daily rates for 2 adults and 2 children, before taxes: 3-service standard (30-amp) C$35 in the very low season, C$48 low, C$67 high (June 12 - September 6 and long weekends); superior 50-amp C$40 / 55 / 77; VIP sites C$45-100. Weekends need 2 nights, holidays 3. The rental sites belong to co-owners; RVs over 12 years old need approval.

Aventure Sentinelle traveller sites: rustic no-service from C$60.95 a night; 3-service 30-amp from C$62.62 (low season) to C$67.95 (high); 3-service 50-amp C$62.62 to C$72.95. No reservation for a single night, no Saturday arrivals or departures, 3 nights on long weekends.

Camping Paradiso traveller sites, before taxes, 2 adults and 4 children: 30-amp 2-3 services C$57, 50-amp 3 services C$60, pull-through 30-amp C$64, 50-amp C$67 a night; +10% during the construction holiday, -10% in the low season, seventh night free.

Klahanie rates page: standard RV sites Monday-Thursday C$60 non-serviced, C$65 power and water; Friday-Sunday C$70 / C$75; ocean- and waterfall-view sites C$75-125. Rates cover 2 adults, 2 kids, 1 vehicle, before GST; a 10% booking fee applies.
Camping La Détente price list: daily site with 2 services C$45, 3 services C$50, taxes included; a week is the daily price less one day; seasonal sites 2026 from C$2,278.76 before taxes.

Camping Plage des Sables Tarifs & Promotions 2026: Voyageur sector 3-service 50-amp site C$68 a night, beach sector with lake view C$78.75, rustic no-service site C$47, all plus tax, for 2 adults and 3 children; weekly and monthly rates too.
Camping La Pinède nightly rates for trailers and RVs: 2 services (water, 30-amp) C$60 weeknights, C$70 weekends; 3 services C$65 / C$75; plus taxes and a booking fee. The 2026 season ended October 5.
Camping Horizon rates for 2 adults and 2 children, taxes extra: 2 services C$52 a day (C$310 for 6 nights, C$985 a month), 3 services 30-50 amp C$65 a day (C$385 / C$1,125).
Gibbs 2027 RV lot rates: 3-service lot C$60 weekdays, C$70 Friday-Sunday, pull-through C$80 a night, for 4 people (extra people C$15 a day); summer reservations May 15 - September 15.
Kayanara booking engine: standard RV campsite rate C$49 for 1 night, 2 guests (Oct 11-12 2026), before 5% GST; weekly and monthly discounts.
